title: Export naming strategy
body:
Change our export strategy to:

``` js
import {connectRange, connectSearchBox} from 'react-instantsearch/connectors';
import {RangeInput, InstantSearch} from 'react-instantsearch/dom';
```

As you can see it's now RangeInput and not Range.Input, we should not attach widgets to other widgets namespaces.

This issue might require or lead to file reorganization since we will no more require to have a single index.js exporting the whole connector + different widgets. It could be named exports or better, only connect in our main index.js.

Previous issues: #1303
